data.one_liner: A pure Dart wrapper library for interacting with the Figma API with typed responses.
data.what_it_does: It provides full Figma API coverage with typed responses and data structures. It supports API tokens and OAuth authentication, variables, component and style handling, comments, webhooks, and export capabilities like PDFs.
use_when: You need to fetch Figma files, styles, components, or variables programmatically in Dart.
You are building automation tools or CI/CD pipelines that interact with Figma data.
avoid_when: You are looking for a Flutter UI component kit or a plugin to render Figma designs directly inside a Flutter app at runtime.
You need a general-purpose HTTP client instead of a specialized Figma API wrapper.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of the Figma API endpoints.
Typed data structures and responses for Figma documents.
Supports both Personal Access Tokens and OAuth authentication.
weaknesses: Relies entirely on Figma's API limits and rate-limiting rules.
Does not render Figma designs natively on device as UI widgets.
data.setup_notes: Obtain a personal access token or set up OAuth from your Figma account settings, then initialize the FigmaClient with the token.
